style: Hand-drawn Czech storybook illustration, like a classic Czech children's book illustrator working in ink and watercolor. A lively, irregular dark brown ink outline of varying thickness, slightly wobbly, drawn by hand around every shape including small details. Flat, slightly textured watercolor washes inside the outlines that spill a little over the line in places and stop short of it in others. Muted natural palette: sage green, olive, earthy clay brown, slate blue-grey, warm cream paper, dusty pastel pink and ochre; small rare accents of brick red and mustard yellow. Minimal shading: only a slightly darker wash and a few hatching strokes or squiggles instead of texture. No gradients, no glow, no bloom, no glossy highlights, no 3D render look, not vector flat design, no saturated candy colors. Characters are drawn simpler than the backgrounds.
notext: No text, letters, digits, numbers, signs, labels, captions, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image.
magenta: Background: one flat solid color, exactly pure magenta #FF00FF, covering the whole canvas edge to edge; no gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast shadow on the ground, no frame, no checkerboard pattern. Do not use magenta or bright pink anywhere inside the drawings.
grid: Square image divided into an invisible 2x2 grid of four equal cells (no lines drawn between them). Each cell holds exactly one subject, centered, filling about 70 percent of its cell, with clear magenta space around it so the four subjects never touch each other or the cell edges.

jobs.prompt: Character model sheet, wide landscape format (about 16:9), plain warm cream paper background, no scenery. Three original characters of a family quiz show, each shown in three poses side by side (front view standing, three-quarter view gesturing, back or side view), clearly separated into three rows. Row 1, the main character: MADAM OWL, a plump tawny owl with soft brown and cream feathers, round amber eyes with small round wire glasses, wearing a hand-knitted sage green vest with a simple cream zigzag pattern and a small brick-red bow at the neck; she holds a few blank question cards; warm, a bit theatrical, friendly. Row 2: the scorekeeper, a cheerful long dachshund dog, reddish-brown, wearing a mustard yellow knitted scarf, holding a pencil and a blank notepad. Row 3: a small round house sparrow messenger, grey-brown, with a tiny slate blue knitted cap, carrying a small blank envelope. Keep anatomy simple and readable, big expressive eyes.

The SAME owl character MADAM OWL from the attached model sheet (tawny owl, round wire glasses, sage green knitted vest with cream zigzag, brick-red bow), full body, four poses: 1) top-left: waving hello with one wing, smiling; 2) top-right: holding up a blank question card, eyebrows raised, asking; 3) bottom-left: cheering with both wings up, tiny confetti of blank paper squares around; 4) bottom-right: thinking, wing tip at the beak, looking up.

Wide landscape illustration, 16:9. A cozy evening in an ordinary Czech family living room-kitchen, seen as a diorama from a gently elevated three-quarter view. A wooden table with a checked tablecloth under a warm hanging lamp. Around it a family playing games: mother and father (adults in their thirties, sweater and flannel shirt), a schoolboy of about nine with a pencil writing on a sheet of paper, and a preschool girl of about five standing on her chair holding up a playing card triumphantly. On the table: scattered playing cards, sheets of paper, pencils, a teapot and mugs of tea, a jug of homemade raspberry lemonade, a bowl of crisps and a small plate of buchty buns. In the background: a tiled stove or radiator, a window with a dark blue evening sky and a panel block with a few lit windows, a kitchen cupboard, a houseplant, a cat sleeping on a chair. The owl MADAM OWL from the attached model sheet sits on top of the cupboard like a quiz host, holding a blank card; the dachshund from the sheet lies under the table. Humor in details. Composition: keep the upper-left third calm and fairly empty (wall and soft lamp light) as space for a title; the family and table on the right and center.

Landscape illustration, 4:3. A Czech village pub quiz night: the owl MADAM OWL from the attached model sheet stands behind the pub counter like a quiz host holding up a blank question card. In front of her, two small tables of players (a family, a pair of grandparents, a young couple) bent over answer sheets with pencils, one raising a hand eagerly. Pub details: wooden panelling, a beer tap, a ceramic stove, antlers on the wall, a coat rack with hats, pints of beer and a lemonade. Diorama view slightly from above.

Landscape illustration, 4:3. A charades and drawing game in a Czech living room: a father mimes something wildly with arms spread like an airplane, a girl draws on a big sheet of paper pinned to a flipchart easel (the drawing is a simple doodle of a house and a cow, no letters), the rest of the family on a sofa guessing and laughing, grandma pointing. An hourglass on the coffee table. Sofa with a crocheted blanket, rubber plant, bookshelf, carpet with a pattern.

Landscape illustration, 4:3. The classic word game played with pencil and paper: a family around a kitchen table, each person hunched over a sheet of paper ruled into columns, writing fast (the sheets show only scribbles and lines, no readable letters). Floating softly above the table as little dream doodles: a small town with a church tower, a fox, a river with a bridge, a plant, a girl's face — the things they are thinking of. A boy chews his pencil thinking hard; a wall clock without numbers. Diorama view from slightly above.

Landscape illustration, 4:3. A game of the Czech card game Prší on a garden table under a pergola on a rainy summer afternoon: grandpa, a girl and a boy play with traditional German-suited playing cards (hearts, leaves, acorns, bells — card faces shown simply, no numbers or letters). Light rain falls outside the pergola onto a vegetable garden, a watering can and rubber boots by the table, a snail on the table leg, steam rising from a mug. The girl slams a card down with a grin.

Landscape illustration, 4:3. Adults playing rummy with French playing cards at a cottage table in the evening: melds of cards laid out in neat rows on the table (card faces simple, suits only as small shapes, no numbers or letters), a jester joker card held up proudly by an aunt, an uncle with a fan of cards in hand frowning, an oil lamp, a bowl of nuts, a dog sleeping by the wood stove, wooden chalet walls with a cuckoo clock without numbers.

Landscape illustration, 4:3. The family game league: a cork pinboard on a kitchen wall full of pinned blank paper sheets, photos of game evenings (simple sketched figures), a hand-drawn chart with little bars and stars, a small homemade trophy cup made of a tin can wrapped in foil, and a calendar page with crossed squares (no numbers). The dachshund scorekeeper from the attached model sheet stands on a stool pinning a new sheet, the sparrow brings an envelope. Below on the kitchen counter: a basket of medals made of cardboard and ribbons.

Wide landscape background illustration, 16:9, for a TV waiting screen. Calm and soft, low detail contrast. The boy reaches out to move a knight, biting his lip in concentration; grandpa strokes his moustache with a sly smile, a few captured pieces lined up beside the board. The owl MADAM OWL from the attached model sheet perches on the back of an armchair behind them, watching the board with one wing raised to her beak.
